name: freellama-native-build
description: Build-only manifest for the napi-rs native addon compiled from packages/rust-core/packages/rust-core/src/napi.rs. Not published — the compiled binary is written into packages/mcp/native, which is the publishable unit.

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path packages/rust-core/Cargo.toml --features napi --no-js --no-dts-header --dts .napi-generated.d.ts -o packages/mcp/native && rm -f packages/mcp/native/.napi-generated.d.ts
